hypothesis: Complete-cart reserves inventory under a lock from the locking module, and the default locking provider is in-memory, so the lock only serializes requests inside one Medusa process. The availability check (available_quantity >= quantity) and the reserved_quantity update (read level, then write level.reserved_quantity + adjustment) are not protected by a database row lock. With two servers sharing one database, two carts each wanting the single SOLO unit completed concurrently on different servers should both pass the availability check and both create reservations, giving live reservations above stocked quantity (oversell), and possibly a lost update on reserved_quantity that also breaks reserved_matches_reservations.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: solo-race-two-servers
description: Two carts each want the single SOLO unit and are completed at the same time on two servers sharing one database.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2
stock:
  SOLO: 1
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
  bob:
    server: 2
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
race:
- id: alice-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice
- id: bob-completes
  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: bob
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 5
  request_timeout_ms: 30000
runs: 50
seed: 7
